title: Long-Range Ferromagnetic Exchange Interactions Mediated by Mn–CeIV–Mn Superexchange Involving Empty 4f Orbitals

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, solid nBu4NMnO4 (0.50 g, 1.38 mmol) was added in small portions to a stirred orange solution of (NH4)2Ce(NO3)6 (0.76 g, 1.38 mmol) and pivalic acid (2.09 g, 20.5 mmol) in MeOH (7.5 mL), causing a rapid color change to dark brown. The solution was stirred for a further 10 min, filtered, and the filtrate left undisturbed at ambient temperature for 1 week, during which time brown microcrystals formed. These were collected by filtration, washed with MeOH, dissolved in CH2Cl2, and layered with MeCN (10 mL) to give X-ray quality brown plate-like crystals of 1·x(solv) over 3 days. The crystallographic sample was kept in mother liquor; otherwise crystals were collected by filtration, washed with MeCN, and dried under vacuum. Yield 22% based on Mn.

properties.summary: Dominant ferromagnetic coupling within the Ce3Mn5 cluster, including long-range Mn–CeIV–Mn ferromagnetic exchange, gives the maximum S = 17/2 ground state. Reduced-magnetization fitting yields g = 1.95(3) and D = −0.14(1) cm−1. AC data confirm S = 17/2 (χMT plateau 38.8 cm3 K mol−1 at 2.4 K, g ~ 1.96) and a very weak frequency-dependent out-of-phase signal, so 1 is a poor SMM. HFEPR at 144 GHz supports the high-spin ferromagnetic ground state.

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, solid nBu4NMnO4 (0.25 g, 0.69 mmol) was added in small portions to a stirred orange solution of (NH4)2Ce(NO3)6 (0.38 g, 0.69 mmol) and benzoic acid (1.25 g, 10.3 mmol) in MeOH/MeCN (15 mL, 1:1 v/v), causing a rapid color change to dark brown. The solution was stirred for a further 20 min, filtered, and the filtrate left undisturbed at ambient temperature for 4 days, during which time X-ray quality dark red plate-like crystals of 2·xMeCN formed. The crystallographic sample was maintained in mother liquor; otherwise crystals were collected by filtration, washed with MeCN, and dried under vacuum. Yield 54% based on Mn.

properties.summary: χMT increases from 8.00 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K to 12.37 cm3 K mol−1 at 10.0 K, then slightly decreases to 12.09 cm3 K mol−1, indicating ferromagnetic coupling including long-range Mn–CeIV–Mn exchange. An isosceles-triangle Van Vleck/Kambe fit gives J1 = +1.0(1) cm−1, J2 = +20.8(4) cm−1, g = 1.99(3) and an S = 5 ground state (~10.1 cm−1 below the first excited state). Reduced magnetization confirms S = 5 with approximate D = −0.40(3) cm−1 and an artifactually low g = 1.82(2).
